finding.root_cause: Batch 08B protocol evidence accepted control-family labels and completed statuses without executing all named failure behaviors or enforcing every frozen file.
finding.impact: The Protocol Baseline V1 decision could overstate protocol-control evidence and must not be used as accepted baseline evidence.

reasons: the freeze candidate was followed by modifications to a declared frozen file
the freeze verifier did not inspect every declared frozen path
multiple protocol failure cases were hardcoded to pass
the protocol artifact did not execute malformed-response, transport-failure or oversized-response behavior
timeout, retry, redaction and audit-reference cases did not prove their named controls
the real capability acceptance predicate omitted mandatory governance and evidence conditions
software scoring trusted provider-declared test results
